subject: Hosted API capacity uplift proposal for Acquify Labs
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Hayes <sam.hayes@acquifylabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API capacity uplift proposal for Acquify Labs
Attachments: Acquify_Redwood_Proposal_v2.pdf

Sam —

Following our call this morning, attached is a concise proposal that maps to the uplift path we discussed. High level:

- Current monthly commit: 3M tokens. Proposed committed baseline: 6M tokens/month (effective immediately on signature).
- Ramp option (preferred by Acquify): 4M month 1 → 5M month 2 → 6M month 3+.
- Rate limits: baseline increased from 60 requests/sec to 120 requests/sec across the account, with a configurable 30s burst window (burst requests counted against burst quota).
- Overage pricing: $0.20 per 1k tokens over committed amount (we can cap the first two months of overage at 50% of listed rate if needed).
- Term: standard 12-month amendment; Sam asked about shorter options — happy to discuss a 9-month pro-rated variant.

I flagged the pricing line items (page 2) and included an implementation checklist (page 4) for ops/engineering to validate rate-limit changes. Next steps:

1) You, Sam, confirm preferred term (9 vs 12 months) and whether you want the ramp.
2) We will issue an amendment (DocuSign) and schedule a 30-minute ops call to validate rate-limit sweeping and caching hooks.
3) On sign, we will revise SLO and send updated monitoring runbook.

If you want an alternative that keeps commit at 5M with a lower monthly fee, say so — I included a fallback tier in the attachment.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if anything is unclear.

— Ava
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Sam Hayes <sam.hayes@acquifylabs.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-06T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity uplift proposal for Acquify Labs

Ava —

Thanks for the write-up and the attachment. A few quick clarifying questions before I share with procurement/ops:

- Can you confirm the per-token price on the 6M commit (line-item on page 2)? The PDF callout is clear but I want the exact number to include in the internal one‑pager.
- We are leaning toward a 9-month term rather than 12 months. Would you be able to pro-rate the committed volume and offer a small credit if we renew early?
- Regarding rate limits: our ops team is most concerned about bursting. Is the 30s burst window a hard cap or configurable, and how do you measure / charge for burst traffic?
- Any options to reduce the initial monthly fee if we front-load payments?

I can review this with Elena (engineering) and procurement@acquifylabs.com once we have the exact pricing & proposed invoice terms.

Sam Hayes
Head of Platform, Acquify Labs
sam.hayes@acquifylabs.com

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-06T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API capacity uplift proposal for Acquify Labs (ops/pricing questions)

Ben/Jordan —

Pasting Sam's reply below. Quick internal thread to align on what we can commit to:

> From: Sam Hayes <sam.hayes@acquifylabs.com>
> To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
> Date: 2027-06-06T10:18:00-07:00
> Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity uplift proposal for Acquify Labs
>
> Ava —
>
> Thanks for the write-up and the attachment. A few quick clarifying questions before I share with procurement/ops:
>
> - Can you confirm the per-token price on the 6M commit (line-item on page 2)? The PDF callout is clear but I want the exact number to include in the internal one‑pager.
> - We are leaning toward a 9-month term rather than 12 months. Would you be able to pro-rate the committed volume and offer a small credit if we renew early?
> - Regarding rate limits: our ops team is most concerned about bursting. Is the 30s burst window a hard cap or configurable, and how do you measure / charge for burst traffic?
> - Any options to reduce the initial monthly fee if we front-load payments?

I recommend the following set of options to reply with (so we keep momentum):

Option A (preferred / fastest to sign):
- 9-month term, ramp 4M → 5M → 6M (month-by-month pro-rate).
- Per-token price for committed volume: $0.012 per 1k tokens. Overage: $0.20 per 1k tokens (cap first 2 months at $0.10).
- Rate limit: 120 rps with 30s burst window; bursts are measured by sustained requests above baseline during 30s sliding window. We do not retro-charge for transient spikes that stay under configured burst quota; longer sustained breaches trigger overage. Bursts are priced as counted tokens in the same overage bucket.
- Payment terms: 30 days net. If Acquify prepays 3 months up-front, offer a 4% prepay discount applied to invoice.

Option B (more conservative):
- 9-month term, commit 5M flat (no ramp). Per-token committed price $0.014 per 1k tokens; overage $0.18 per 1k. Rate limit increase to 100 rps (smaller ops change).

Proposed next actions: Ben — confirm discount approval and if legal needs a special clause for burst handling. Jordan — please confirm ops runbook & whether we need a staging test to increase rps safely (and timing).

I will fold this into a short reply to Sam once you both sign off.

— Ava

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Hayes <sam.hayes@acquifylabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity uplift proposal for Acquify Labs
Attachments: Acquify_Amendment_v1.docx

Sam —

Thanks for the quick review. We spoke internally and can move forward on Option A with a small tweak to protect both sides. Summary of agreed commercial/ops points: 

- Term & volume: 9-month amendment with ramp: Month 1 = 4M tokens, Month 2 = 5M tokens, Month 3–9 = 6M tokens/month.
- Pricing: committed volume price = $0.012 per 1k tokens. Overage = $0.20 per 1k tokens; first 2 months after go-live overage capped at $0.10 per 1k to smooth onboarding.
- Rate limits: account-level baseline increased to 120 rps with a 30s configurable burst window. Bursts are measured via a 30s sliding window; short spikes within your allocated burst quota are not charged. Sustained traffic beyond burst quota counts against overage tokens. We will share the monitoring dashboard and an ops runbook before go-live.
- Payment & credits: Net 30 invoicing. If Acquify prepays 3 months, we will apply a 4% prepay credit. Early renewal credit: if Acquify signs a renewal for >=12 months during the 9-month amendment, we will issue a one-time credit equal to 5% of the remaining committed value.

Attached is a draft amendment (Acquify_Amendment_v1.docx). If that looks good, sign via the DocuSign link below and we'll schedule the ops validation call for next week.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/Acquify/Envelope/12345
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACQ-2027-062

Next steps:
- Sam: confirm acceptance of these bullets and preferred go-live date (we recommend 2027-06-15).
- Ben: I cc'd you to track legal/finance approval and finalize amendment language.
- Jordan: once signed, work with Elena and Acquify ops to run the rate-limit staging test (target window: 6/14).

Appreciate the momentum — happy to hop on a call to run through the amendment.

— Ava
